book.name: Akatecholonike
book.title: Baluwa jhubhele jha Pauli kwa Akatecholonike

content: Ngohe tunnyandikila lilobhe lya kuhika kwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu na tupala kukonganika palonge jhake. Makalongo bhito tumpembelekeya hake,
mundo akoto kummoghana kajhombe chikibhii umuto gwino, amu nkoto kuhechuka na ujumbi amu lilobhe amu baluwa jhilongelwa ihumite kwito, baluwa jhilongela lichiko lya Bhambo lihikiti njwe.
Mundo jhojhoha akoto kunkolowa na kilebhe chochoha, nhwalo lichiko lela lihika jhe ade mundo jhola jwankana Chapanga na uchakaka abhonekane, kujhomolela kwake kukomolekelwa.

Jwenio nakikana kila kilebhe na chakitenda jwenio ndi nkolongwa jwa kila kilebhe chikikemwa kichapanga, amu chibhikijhinamila, yenio ata nakujhingii nkate jha Nyumba jha Chapanga nakiloka kubhehe ndi Chapanga.
Bho, mikombokajhe nakannobholile ghanga ghoha punikibha pamonga na mangota?
Nambo kibhii kilebhe chikinhibhilikiya ngohe, na mangota mu kimanya kilebhe chenie. Nambo lichiko lyake anda lihikite, jwankema Jwanganandela Mundo nabhonekana.
Nambo ngohe likakala lya Mundo Jwanganandela lihenga lihengo kwa kuyepela, nambo nabhonekana jhe ade jhola jwanhibhilikiye abhowe.
Ndi Mundo Jwanganandela nabhonekana, nambo papakuhika Bhambo Yecho nankoma kwa uhuke gwa nnomo gwake na kunkomelekeya kwa lung'anye lwake lukolongwa.
Jwenio Mundo Jwanganandela chahika na likakala lya Limbembela na kuhenga kila ikangacho na nginyililo yu uwange,
na kuntumii ghoha ghu uwange kwa bhala bhubhabhii mu kuhobholela. Bheniya nabhahobholela nhwalo bhaupokii jhe na kupala uchakaka bhaghombokoke.
Nhwalo Chapanga bhabhekite bhando bheniya pahe jha makakala gha kuhobholela, bhaujheketele uwange.
Yene bhoha bhangajheketela uchakaka, nambo bhihanganila uhakaho, nabhahadabulwa.

Nambo tupalwa kunnomba Chapanga machiko ghoha nhwalo gwino mangota, mangota mupailwe na Bhambo, nhwalo kuhumii makacho Chapanga abhahagwile nghombokoke kwa likakala lya Uhuke gwake, na kuntenda mme bhando bhake bhanyahinyahi kwa kihobholelo chino mu uchakaka.
Chapanga ankemita mangota kupete Lilobhe lya Mbone lituntangachila mme pamonga mung'alicho gwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu.
Ngohe makalongo bhango, nnyemengane nganganga na kukamuu mabholo ghutummolite anda kuntangachii amu kunyandikila.
Tunnyopa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu jwenio na Chapanga Tate gwito jwatupahile, na kwa umbone gwake atupekii uteeke gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta na lihobholelo lya umbone,
apepeche miojho na ankangamaliche nhoto kuhenga nu kulonge ghambone.
